# FG_02 in TwinCAT

The control side only. What FG_02 *is* - its scene hierarchy, its devices and everything a human authored about it - is in the main repo: [`FG_02`](https://github.com/Preliy/DT_PSA_OPCV/blob/master/_docs/context/fg-02.md).

## Components

| Symbol | Device type | Twin FB | Control PLC path | I/O | Linked |
|---|---|---|---|---:|---:|
| `P_Camera` | DataReader | `FB_Camera` | `MAIN.Machine.FG_02.P_Camera` | 2 | 2 |

**The twin path is not the control path.** Only the control PLC path works in an HMI binding or a `TcLinkTo` pragma, and the twin's spelling fails silently in both.
